name: HashKey Holdings Limited
summary: HashKey Holdings Limited develops a licensed digital asset platform to provide transaction facilitation services, on-chain services, and asset management services. The company's platform has the capability to issue and circulate tokenised RWAs, and offers HashKey Chain, a scalable and interoperable Layer 2 infrastructure to support on-chain migration. The company's transaction facilitation services business offers a full suite of services, including digital asset exchange, brokerage services and custody services.
